title: Native UI Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/native_design_audit.mjs — a normalized description of a native iOS/macOS design's HIG-relevant properties.

component.description: Optional name of the screen/component/flow being audited.

usesSfSymbolsNotEmojiIcons.description: True only if every UI icon is an SF Symbol (or an equivalent custom vector) — never an emoji used as an icon.

honorsDynamicType.description: True only if body/prose text scales with the system Dynamic Type accessibility setting instead of using hard-coded point sizes.

minTapTargetPt.description: The smallest interactive control's tap target size, in points (width and height are assumed equal or this is the smaller dimension).

minBodyFontPt.description: The smallest body/prose/caption font size anywhere in the design, in points.

respectsSafeAreas.description: True only if layout avoids notch/Dynamic Island/home-indicator intrusion for interactive or critical content.

lightAndDark.description: True only if both light and dark appearances are implemented using semantic colors (not a single hard-coded palette).

contrastMinRatio.description: The worst-case (lowest) text/background contrast ratio anywhere in the design.

usesSystemMaterials.description: True if chrome/overlay surfaces use system materials (.ultraThinMaterial, .regularMaterial, etc.) rather than flat/opaque fills.
